mechanism.claim: At a fixed four-hour boundary, an unusually volatile completed BTC block whose second two hours realize at least 1.5 times the first-half variation while both half-block returns share a sign represents accelerating price discovery. Follow that common direction for two elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: common nonzero sign of completed first- and second-two-hour returns
mechanism.why_distinct: FHVAR uses two nonoverlapping two-hour realized-variation halves in a fixed four-hour block. JVIAR used intrahour half-hour returns under joint BVOL/DVOL expansion; DVBCR used one daily variance center. FHVAR uses neither options data nor either event set.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the full completed four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: six fixed UTC acceleration clocks with within-block variance geometry are absent from Gross9

features.block_valid: 240 exact distinct minute rows in [decision-4h,decision), finite positive coherent OHLC; no imputation
features.first_return: log(close at decision-2h-1m / open at decision-4h)
features.second_return: log(close at decision-1m / open at decision-2h)
features.realized_variation: sum squared 1m close-to-close log returns within each half; the boundary return from the first-half close to second-half open is excluded
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank among at most 180 valid fixed four-hour blocks, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.direction_confirmation: first_return and second_return have the same strict nonzero sign

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, variation, or subset repair.
